blocks.zh: Section 3: Lifecycle Management & Post-Approval Changes｜生命週期管理與上市後變更
blocks.en: Section 3: Lifecycle Management & Post-Approval Changes

blocks.zh: §7 生命週期管理與上市後變更
blocks.en: §7 Lifecycle Management and Post-Approval Changes

blocks.zh: 分析方法變更的類型與驅動因素
blocks.en: Types and Drivers of Analytical Procedure Changes

blocks.zh: 分析方法變更可分為兩大類：
blocks.en: Analytical procedure changes fall into two broad categories:

blocks.zh: 現有方法的修改：調整參數、更新試劑規格、優化分離條件等
blocks.en: Modification of an existing procedure: adjusting parameters, updating reagent specifications, optimizing separation conditions, etc.

blocks.zh: 全面替換：引入全新技術（如從 HPLC-UV 改為 LC-MS/MS）
blocks.en: Complete replacement: introducing an entirely new technology (e.g., changing from HPLC-UV to LC-MS/MS)

blocks.zh: 三大驅動因素：
blocks.en: Three main drivers:

blocks.zh: 重要：重大變更可能觸發 ATP 重新評估
blocks.en: Important: A Major Change May Trigger Reassessment of the ATP

blocks.zh: 若變更導致：(1) 性能特性出現重大差異，或 (2) 對品質屬性產生額外資訊（如新的降解產物資訊）→ 需重新評估 ATP，甚至建立全新的分析方法。
blocks.en: If a change results in (1) a significant difference in performance characteristics, or (2) additional information on a quality attribute (such as information on a new degradation product), the ATP needs to be reassessed, and even an entirely new analytical procedure may need to be established.

blocks.zh: 這是 Q14 生命週期管理理念的核心：ATP 不是靜態文件，應隨產品知識增加而更新。
blocks.en: This is central to the Q14 lifecycle management philosophy: the ATP is not a static document and should be updated as product knowledge grows.

blocks.zh: §7 Q12 六工具在分析程序的應用
blocks.en: §7 Applying the Six ICH Q12 Tools to Analytical Procedures

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 六工具：映射到分析方法管理
blocks.en: The Six ICH Q12 Tools: Mapped to Analytical Procedure Management

blocks.zh: 無 ECs 時的申報路徑
blocks.en: Reporting Pathway When There Are No ECs

blocks.zh: 若申請人在申報文件中未提出 ECs（即採用 minimal approach），則所有分析方法變更均需依照地區性申報要求處理。
blocks.en: If the applicant has not proposed ECs in the submission (i.e., has taken the minimal approach), all analytical procedure changes must be handled according to regional reporting requirements.

blocks.zh: 這通常意味著更多的前置核准（Prior Approval Supplement），而 enhanced approach + ECs 則可透過 PACMP 或通知（Notification）等更快速的路徑處理變更。
blocks.en: This usually means more Prior Approval Supplements, whereas the enhanced approach + ECs allows changes to be handled through faster pathways such as a PACMP or Notification.

blocks.zh: Figure 2🔍：風險分類與申報類別決策框架
blocks.en: Figure 2🔍: Decision Framework for Risk Classification and Reporting Category

blocks.zh: 三層申報類別：適用於分析方法變更
blocks.en: Three Reporting Categories: Applied to Analytical Procedure Changes

blocks.zh: 注意：法規機關在審查時可能將公司提案的 Notification 升級為 Prior Approval（基於健康主管機關回饋），申請人不能單方面決定最終類別。
blocks.en: Note: during assessment, the regulatory authority may upgrade a company-proposed Notification to Prior Approval (based on feedback from the health authority); the applicant cannot decide the final category unilaterally.

blocks.zh: 風險等級決定因素
blocks.en: Factors That Determine the Risk Level

blocks.zh: 類比：修改食譜的不同程度
blocks.en: Analogy: Different Degrees of Changing a Recipe

blocks.zh: 想像一道食譜代表一個分析方法：
blocks.en: Imagine that a recipe represents an analytical procedure:

blocks.zh: PQS-only（烤箱溫度從 180°C 調到 185°C）：在 PAR 範圍內的微調，廚師（分析師）自行調整，無需請示主廚（法規機關）
blocks.en: PQS-only (oven temperature from 180°C to 185°C): a small adjustment within the PAR; the cook (the analyst) makes it without asking the head chef (the regulatory authority)

blocks.zh: Notification（更換同型規格烤盤）：有一定影響，告知主廚即可（通知），不需等候批准
blocks.en: Notification (replacing the baking tray with one of the same specification): some impact, so the head chef is simply informed (notification) and no approval is awaited

blocks.zh: Prior Approval（從烘烤改為油炸）：方法原理完全改變，需要主廚預先批准（前置核准），並重新全面驗證
blocks.en: Prior Approval (changing from baking to deep-frying): the principle of the method changes completely, so the head chef's approval is required in advance (prior approval) and full revalidation is needed

blocks.zh: PAR/MODR 就像「廚師的自由調整空間」——在此範圍內移動，完全在 PQS 內部管理，無需申報。
blocks.en: The PAR/MODR is like "the cook's freedom to adjust": movement within this range is managed entirely inside the PQS and needs no filing.

blocks.zh: Table 1：知識 × 風險 → 研究設計矩陣
blocks.en: Table 1: Knowledge × Risk → Study Design Matrix

blocks.zh: 2×2 矩陣詳解：四種情境的研究策略
blocks.en: The 2×2 Matrix in Detail: Study Strategy for Four Scenarios

blocks.zh: Table 1 的核心邏輯：知識可降低研究負擔，但無法消除風險要求
blocks.en: Core Logic of Table 1: Knowledge Can Reduce the Study Burden but Cannot Remove the Risk Requirement

blocks.zh: 知識的作用：高知識 → 可以設計更精準（而非更廣泛）的研究，以目標性確認代替全面探索性研究。
blocks.en: Role of knowledge: high knowledge → studies can be designed to be more targeted (rather than broader), with targeted confirmation replacing comprehensive exploratory studies.

blocks.zh: 風險的作用：高風險 → 無論知識多少，都需要更深入的研究（in-depth study）來支持更高的申報類別或降低申報類別的依據。
blocks.en: Role of risk: high risk → however much knowledge there is, a more in-depth study is needed to support a higher reporting category or to justify a lower one.

blocks.zh: 最優情境：高知識 + 低風險 → 最少研究量，此時 PQS-only 或 Notification 是可能的申報路徑。
blocks.en: Optimal scenario: high knowledge + low risk → the smallest amount of study; PQS-only or Notification is then a possible reporting pathway.

blocks.zh: 橋接研究（Bridging Study）的概念也適用於方法的場地轉移（site transfer）。即使方法本身不變，轉移到不同實驗室也需要評估。
blocks.en: The concept of a bridging study also applies to site transfer of a procedure. Even if the procedure itself does not change, transfer to a different laboratory needs to be assessed.

blocks.zh: ATP 作為 PACMP 的基礎
blocks.en: The ATP as the Basis for a PACMP

blocks.zh: PACMP 應用於分析方法的實際效益
blocks.en: Practical Benefits of Using a PACMP for Analytical Procedures

blocks.zh: 什麼是 PACMP？ Post-Approval Change Management Protocol — 一種預先與法規機關約定的「未來變更路徑圖」。當特定預定條件達成時，可按照較低申報類別進行變更。
blocks.en: What is a PACMP? Post-Approval Change Management Protocol: a "roadmap for future changes" agreed in advance with the regulatory authority. When specified predefined conditions are met, the change can be made under a lower reporting category.

blocks.zh: ATP 如何成為 PACMP 的基礎？
blocks.en: How does the ATP become the basis for a PACMP?

blocks.zh: ATP 定義了方法必須達到的性能標準（如：準確度 95–105%，精密度 RSD ≤ 5%）
blocks.en: The ATP defines the performance criteria the procedure must meet (e.g., accuracy 95–105%, precision RSD ≤ 5%)

blocks.zh: 在 PACMP 中約定：若未來新方法（如 LC-MS/MS）滿足 ATP 要求 + 完成橋接研究，則可按 Notification 申報，而非 Prior Approval
blocks.en: The PACMP agrees that if a future new procedure (such as LC-MS/MS) meets the ATP requirements + a bridging study is completed, the change can be reported as a Notification rather than Prior Approval

blocks.zh: 法規機關審批 PACMP → 未來執行變更時直接按計劃操作，效率大幅提升
blocks.en: The regulatory authority approves the PACMP → when the change is made in future, it is executed directly according to the plan, greatly improving efficiency

blocks.zh: 實際案例場景：
blocks.en: Example scenario:

blocks.zh: 公司預計未來 3 年內可能將效力測定從細胞測定更換為受體結合測定
blocks.en: The company expects that within the next 3 years it may replace the potency assay from a cell-based assay with a receptor-binding assay

blocks.zh: 在申請時即建立 PACMP：定義驗收標準（ATP）、橋接研究計劃、可接受的可比性標準
blocks.en: A PACMP is established at the time of the application: it defines the acceptance criteria (the ATP), the bridging study plan and the acceptable comparability criteria

blocks.zh: 未來執行時：按 PACMP 計劃完成研究 → 以 Notification 申報，而非等候 Prior Approval（可節省 12–18 個月）
blocks.en: At the time of execution: complete the studies according to the PACMP → report as a Notification rather than waiting for Prior Approval (which can save 12–18 months)

blocks.zh: Table 2：三種分析方法變更情境全解
blocks.en: Table 2: The Three Analytical Procedure Change Scenarios Explained

blocks.zh: 三種情境的完整對比
blocks.en: Full Comparison of the Three Scenarios

blocks.zh: 三種情境的共同「適用性證據」要求
blocks.en: Common "Suitability Evidence" Requirements for the Three Scenarios

blocks.zh: 無論哪種情境，必須提供：
blocks.en: Whichever scenario applies, the following must be provided:

blocks.zh: 分析方法性能特性已評估且符合標準（包括 ATP 要求）
blocks.en: The performance characteristics of the analytical procedure have been evaluated and meet the criteria (including the ATP requirements)

blocks.zh: 結果具有可比性（或差異可接受，且已評估對規格的潛在影響）
blocks.en: The results are comparable (or any differences are acceptable and their potential impact on the specification has been assessed)

blocks.zh: 可比性分析的材料選擇：應使用「代表性樣品」（包括邊緣批次、降解樣品）+ 參考材料，確保新方法的區分能力與舊方法相當。
blocks.en: Choice of materials for the comparability analysis: use "representative samples" (including edge-of-failure batches and degraded samples) + reference materials, to ensure that the discriminating power of the new procedure is equivalent to that of the old one.

blocks.zh: 類比：食譜的三種改變程度
blocks.en: Analogy: Three Degrees of Changing a Recipe

blocks.zh: 以「製作蛋糕」（= 分析方法）為例：
blocks.en: Take "baking a cake" (= an analytical procedure) as an example:

blocks.zh: 情境 1（改變原理）= 從烘烤改為油炸：烹飪原理完全不同，需要完整重新測試成品品質，並確認結果（口感、外觀）仍能區分「合格品」與「不合格品」
blocks.en: Scenario 1 (change of principle) = changing from baking to deep-frying: the cooking principle is completely different, so the quality of the finished product must be fully retested, and it must be confirmed that the results (texture, appearance) can still distinguish "acceptable" from "unacceptable" product

blocks.zh: 情境 2（同原理內變更）= 更換同規格烤箱品牌：原理不變，但需要確認溫度特性相符，可能只需重新測試部分品質指標（如均勻性）
blocks.en: Scenario 2 (change within the same principle) = switching to an oven of the same specification from a different brand: the principle is unchanged, but it must be confirmed that the temperature characteristics match, and only some quality indicators (such as uniformity) may need to be retested

blocks.zh: 情境 3（場地轉移）= 把食譜交給另一個廚房使用：食譜本身不變，但需要確認另一個廚房的設備和技術人員能達到同樣結果，或若廚房本身已有充分的資質認定，可豁免額外測試
blocks.en: Scenario 3 (site transfer) = handing the recipe to another kitchen: the recipe itself is unchanged, but it must be confirmed that the other kitchen's equipment and staff can achieve the same result, or, if that kitchen is already adequately qualified, the additional testing can be waived

blocks.zh: §7 製品/製程變更與全新分析方法的引入
blocks.en: §7 Product/Process Changes and Introducing a New Analytical Procedure

blocks.zh: 製品或製程變更如何影響分析方法
blocks.en: How Product or Process Changes Affect the Analytical Procedure

blocks.zh: 製品或製程的任何重大變更都可能觸發分析方法的重新評估：
blocks.en: Any significant change to the product or process may trigger reassessment of the analytical procedure:

blocks.zh: ATP 若已建立，應首先評估現有 ATP 是否仍然適用；若不適用，需更新 ATP，然後評估現有分析方法是否仍能滿足更新後的 ATP。
blocks.en: If an ATP has been established, first assess whether the existing ATP is still applicable; if not, the ATP must be updated, and then assess whether the existing analytical procedure can still meet the updated ATP.

blocks.zh: 提出全新分析方法時的三步驟
blocks.en: Three Steps When Proposing an Entirely New Analytical Procedure

blocks.zh: 全面風險評估：評估新方法引入的風險（技術複雜性、CQA 關鍵性、與原方法的差異程度）
blocks.en: Comprehensive risk assessment: assess the risks introduced by the new procedure (technical complexity, CQA criticality, degree of difference from the original procedure)

blocks.zh: 建立新的方法控制策略：確認新方法的 ECs、SST 標準、PAR/MODR（若適用）
blocks.en: Establish a new procedure control strategy: confirm the ECs, SST criteria and PAR/MODR (if applicable) for the new procedure

blocks.zh: 申報溝通中論證 ECs：在變更申請中提供充分的科學依據，說明新方法的 ECs 選擇與申報類別的合理性
blocks.en: Justify the ECs in the regulatory communication: provide sufficient scientific justification in the change application to explain the choice of ECs for the new procedure and the appropriateness of the reporting category

blocks.zh: PQS 在生命週期管理中的角色
blocks.en: The Role of the PQS in Lifecycle Management

blocks.zh: PQS（藥品品質系統）是所有分析方法變更的「記憶體」：
blocks.en: The PQS (pharmaceutical quality system) is the "memory" for all analytical procedure changes:

blocks.zh: 需要申報的變更：同時在 PQS 和法規申請文件中記錄
blocks.en: Changes that must be reported: recorded in both the PQS and the regulatory submission

blocks.zh: 不需要申報的變更（如 PAR/MODR 範圍內的調整）：僅在 PQS 中記錄，但記錄必須完整（包括變更原因、評估結果、批准記錄）
blocks.en: Changes that need not be reported (such as adjustments within the PAR/MODR): recorded in the PQS only, but the record must be complete (including the reason for the change, the assessment results and the approval record)

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 合規性：PQS 的變更管理流程需符合 ICH Q12 建議，不能是單純的文件記錄，需有完整的變更評估和批准流程
blocks.en: ICH Q12 compliance: the PQS change management process must conform to ICH Q12 recommendations; it cannot be a simple documentation exercise and needs a complete change assessment and approval process

blocks.zh: 綜合應用問題
blocks.en: Integrated Application Question

blocks.zh: 某公司計劃將其原料藥（Drug Substance）的 HPLC 含量分析方法更換為 LC-MS/MS 方法（分析方法原理改變）。請問：(1) 需要進行哪些橋接研究？(2) 此變更通常適用哪種申報類別？(3) 如果公司希望降低申報類別，有哪些可能的工具？
blocks.en: A company plans to replace the HPLC assay procedure for its drug substance with an LC-MS/MS procedure (a change in the analytical principle). (1) What bridging studies are needed? (2) Which reporting category usually applies to this change? (3) If the company wants a lower reporting category, what tools might be available?

blocks.zh: 解答
blocks.en: Answer

blocks.zh: (1) 橋接研究要求（Table 2，情境 1 — 改變分析方法原理）：
blocks.en: (1) Bridging study requirements (Table 2, Scenario 1: change of analytical procedure principle):

blocks.zh: 全面驗證（Full Validation）：新 LC-MS/MS 方法需按 ICH Q2 進行全面驗證，包括專一性、線性、範圍、準確度、精密度、偵測限/定量限（若適用）、穩健性
blocks.en: Full validation: the new LC-MS/MS procedure needs full validation per ICH Q2, including specificity, linearity, range, accuracy, precision, detection limit/quantitation limit (if applicable) and robustness

blocks.zh: 代表性樣品的比較分析：需使用代表性批次樣品（包括邊緣批次、壓力降解樣品）同時以新舊兩種方法分析，確認結果一致性
blocks.en: Comparative analysis of representative samples: representative batch samples (including edge-of-failure batches and forced degradation samples) must be analyzed with both the new and old procedures at the same time to confirm consistency of results

blocks.zh: 參考材料比較：參考標準品在兩種方法下的分析結果需具有可比性
blocks.en: Reference material comparison: the results for the reference standard under the two procedures must be comparable

blocks.zh: 區分能力確認：新方法對於可接受（合格）vs. 不可接受（不合格）樣品的區分能力，必須與原 HPLC 方法相當
blocks.en: Confirmation of discriminating power: the new procedure's ability to distinguish acceptable (conforming) from unacceptable (non-conforming) samples must be equivalent to that of the original HPLC procedure

blocks.zh: (2) 申報類別：通常為 Prior Approval（前置核准），因為：
blocks.en: (2) Reporting category: usually Prior Approval, because:

blocks.zh: 分析方法原理改變（HPLC-UV → LC-MS/MS）= 高程度變更
blocks.en: The analytical principle changes (HPLC-UV → LC-MS/MS) = a high degree of change

blocks.zh: 原料藥含量分析 = 關鍵 CQA，直接關係到安全性和療效
blocks.en: Drug substance assay = a critical CQA, directly related to safety and efficacy

blocks.zh: 根據 Figure 2🔍 的風險評估邏輯：高 CQA 關鍵性 + 高變更程度 → Prior Approval
blocks.en: According to the risk assessment logic of Figure 2🔍: high CQA criticality + high degree of change → Prior Approval

blocks.zh: (3) 降低申報類別的工具：
blocks.en: (3) Tools for lowering the reporting category:

blocks.zh: PACMP（首選）：若在最初申請時已建立 PACMP，預先定義 LC-MS/MS 的驗收標準和橋接研究計劃，可以按 Notification 申報
blocks.en: PACMP (preferred): if a PACMP was established at the time of the original application, with the acceptance criteria and bridging study plan for LC-MS/MS defined in advance, the change can be reported as a Notification

blocks.zh: ECs + 充分先驗知識：若公司有豐富的 LC-MS/MS 平台知識，且現有 HPLC 方法的 ATP 和 ECs 已完善定義，可在申報中提供全面的風險評估以支持較低申報類別
blocks.en: ECs + sufficient prior knowledge: if the company has extensive LC-MS/MS platform knowledge and the ATP and ECs of the existing HPLC procedure are well defined, a comprehensive risk assessment can be provided in the submission to support a lower reporting category

blocks.zh: 限制：即使有上述工具，法規機關仍有最終決定權，中等風險的公司提案可能被要求升級為 Prior Approval
blocks.en: Limitation: even with the tools above, the regulatory authority has the final say, and a company proposal at moderate risk may be required to be upgraded to Prior Approval
